source_review.basis: Direct review of the benchmark PDF; this is a deliberate non-corrosion routing control.

routing_contract.reason: The focal system is olivine LiFePO4/C cathode material for lithium-ion batteries. EIS/Nyquist vocabulary alone is insufficient evidence for corrosion ownership.

positive_battery_evidence: Title: Electrochemical Properties of Olivine-Type LiFePO4/C Cathode Material for Lithium Ion Batteries
Keywords include lithium ion batteries, LiFePO4, electrochemical impedance spectroscopy, conductive additive
Electrodes are LiFePO4 composite cathodes with graphite conductive additive and PVDF binder
Electrochemical setup uses Li foil and reports charge/discharge cycling, cyclic voltammetry and EIS
The paper reports specific discharge capacity and capacity retention for LiFePO4/G electrodes

source_context.electrolyte: 1 mol L^-1 LiPF6 in ethylene carbonate/dimethyl carbonate/diethyl carbonate (1:1:1 volume ratio)
